newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bel-20 to pause post-peak, various ratings changed.
newsitem.headline: Bel-20 to pause post-peak, various ratings changed.

text.p: 0740 GMT - Bel-20 share index expected to start mixed with a firmer bias; Dow Jones gain of 49 points, firmer bonds positives, but bourse in uncharted territory after Tuesday's record close and valuations stretched; though fundamentals are sound, they have been so for months now and new developments are needed to justify further gains, dealers say.
* Generale Bank downgrades Union Miniere to 'hold' from 'buy', but upgrades Arbed to 'buy' from 'hold'; Kredietbank rates Generale Bank a 'reduce', UCB an 'accumulate'.
